blurb: Guests sail on a 1999 Grand Soleil 46.3 luxury racing cruiser with up to 6 guests per charter. Tours include wildlife viewing and coastline sailing with opportunities to participate or take the helm. The yacht is fully equipped with galley, entertainment systems, and comfort items like jackets and blankets.
